ReextractPreview.bannerRetryHint: Retrying fetches the images again, then reads the post again.

ReextractPreview.startRefused: Re-extract could not be started. Try again in a moment.

ReextractPreview.notStoredNote: post is not in the database: no account signal, and authorship is assumed to be the organizer's
ReextractPreview.alreadyRepresented: Ingestion would skip this: already represented by
ReextractPreview.applyExplainer: Apply makes the post's events match this preview: its existing events keep their link, favorites and calendar entries and take this preview's details, and the other items become new linked events. No event is deleted. A schedule this preview no longer lists is removed from a kept event unless someone's calendar uses it, and fields a moderator corrected are kept. An event whose first post is another post is left as it is and only gains this post's link.
ReextractPreview.applyExplainerRoundup: Apply makes the post look like this preview: its existing events keep their link, favorites and calendar entries, take this preview's details and show as roundup stubs, and the other items become new linked stub events. No event is deleted. A schedule this preview no longer lists is removed from a kept event unless someone's calendar uses it, and fields a moderator corrected are kept. An event whose first post is another post is left as it is and only gains this post's link.
ReextractPreview.applyConfirmDescription: The post's grouping is rewritten and its events are updated to match this preview. No event is deleted and no one is notified, but this cannot be undone from here. Duplicate matching now also uses venue coordinates, so an item shown here as a new event may be merged into an existing one.
ReextractPreview.applyFailed: The preview could not be applied, and nothing was changed. Please try again.
ReextractPreview.appliedReused: {count, plural, one {# existing event kept (same link, favorites and calendar entries)} other {# existing events kept (same links, favorites and calendar entries)}}
ReextractPreview.appliedCreated: {count, plural, one {# new event created} other {# new events created}}
ReextractPreview.appliedLinked: {count, plural, one {# item merged into an existing event} other {# items merged into existing events}}
ReextractPreview.appliedQueued: {count, plural, one {# possible duplicate queued for review} other {# possible duplicates queued for review}}
ReextractPreview.appliedSkippedDeleted: {count, plural, one {# item skipped: its event was deleted by a moderator} other {# items skipped: their events were deleted by a moderator}}
ReextractPreview.appliedOrphans: These events of the post matched nothing in this extraction and were left as they are:
ReextractPreview.previewOnlyNote: Venue matching in this preview uses the location text only (no geocoding). Ingestion skips an item whose post and position already have an event, so a re-run does not change existing events; only Apply does.
